lastCompletedStory.title: Runtime drain kill-switch: marker primitive + cam drain command

nextStoryContext: US-002 is done. DRAIN_STOP_MARKER ('.cam-drain-stop') is exported from src/supervisor/drain-kill-switch.ts with set/clear/isDrainStopSet helpers (injectable fs seams). 'cam drain --stop' writes the marker; 'cam drain --clear' removes it; 'cam drain' prints status. 'cam stop' clears it as part of marker cleanup (stop.ts loop). The next story (US-003) adds a fail-closed hard-precondition gate: before the auto-drain loop starts a new cycle, it must check isDrainStopSet and refuse to proceed if set. The marker module and command are the building blocks already in place.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 touches only project-internal modules (node:fs, path primitives). No external library API was exercised.
